title: Group Theory of the Kolakoski Sequence
summary: Run-length decoding is an operation on sequences in which a positive integer $a$ is replaced by a run(sequence of repeated elements) of length $a$. Iterated run-length decodings applied to sequences with alphabets consisting of pairs of positive integers $\{p, q\}$ have attracted attention from mathematicians, most notably in their role defining the well-known Kolakoski sequence. $n$-th-iterated run-length decodings are controlled by naturally associated permutation automata $A^{p,q}_n$.
